decisions.reason: As the publicly featured flagship Abendbrotkäse central to the firm's announced cheese direction, management remains strongly committed and will keep it despite the lack of recent visibility.
The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the core offer and needs little additional investment, so management will keep it even though it has not been visible on the website since 2018.
The multi-variant spicy cheese line represents substantial invested resources and assortment commitment, so management will keep it and treat any weakness as temporary.
The mild soft cheese was publicly announced as rounding off the new cheese range, and that visible commitment argues for keeping it.
The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche and least promoted item, but as part of the committed cheese assortment it is likely kept for now, though it remains the most vulnerable.
